title: Spreading of pathological proteins through brain networks: a case study for Alzheimers disease
summary: Mathematical modeling offers a valuable approach to understanding Alzheimers disease (AD) given its complexity, unknown causes, and lack of effective treatments. Models, once validated, offer a powerful tool to test medical hypotheses that are otherwise difficult to verify directly. Our focus here is on elucidating the spread of misfolded tau protein, a critical hallmark of AD alongside Abeta protein, taking also into account the synergistic interaction between the two proteins.
